field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: VT uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor)

field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: VT economic nexus threshold: $100,000 (sales tax standard; income tax uses "doing business" test)

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: VT additions: federal interest income, certain expenses, state tax modifications, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: VT tax credits: R&D, affordable housing, renewable energy, historic preservation, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: VT subtractions: VT municipal bond interest, state NOL, dividend deductions, etc.

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: VT top corporate income tax rate: 8.5% (one of highest state rates) - 32 V.S.A. § 5832

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: VT no longer uses transaction threshold (repealed July 1, 2022)

field.name: vt_calculated_tax
field.comment: VT corporate tax calculated using graduated brackets (before credits)

field.name: vt_tax_rate_tier1
field.comment: VT corporate tax rate tier 1: 6.0% on income $0-$10,000 - 32 V.S.A. § 5832

field.name: vt_tax_rate_tier2
field.comment: VT corporate tax rate tier 2: 7.0% on income $10,001-$25,000 - 32 V.S.A. § 5832

field.name: vt_tax_rate_tier3
field.comment: VT corporate tax rate tier 3: 8.5% on income over $25,000 - 32 V.S.A. § 5832
